requirements.text: The game should be called 'Dojo Duel'.
requirements.check: The game window title displays 'Dojo Duel'.
requirements.quote: Create a tiny one-screen 2D fighting game called "Dojo Duel".

requirements.text: Player controls a red-belt martial artist on the left.
requirements.check: A red-belt fighter sprite is visible on the left side of the screen at game start.
requirements.quote: The player controls a red-belt martial artist on the left

requirements.text: A blue-belt rival controlled by the computer stands on the right.
requirements.check: A blue-belt fighter sprite is visible on the right side of the screen at game start.
requirements.quote: a blue-belt rival controlled by the computer stands on the right.

requirements.text: Both fighters stand on a plain wooden-brown floor.
requirements.check: A wooden-brown rectangular area is drawn at the bottom of the screen, and both fighters are positioned on top of it.
requirements.quote: Use a plain wooden-brown floor

requirements.text: The background should be a light colour.
requirements.check: The background of the game window is filled with a light, solid color.
requirements.quote: a light background colour instead of a background image.

requirements.text: Both fighters have simple gravity.
requirements.check: When a fighter jumps, they fall back to the floor after reaching the apex of their jump.
requirements.quote: Both fighters stand on the floor with simple gravity.

requirements.text: Left arrow key walks the player left.
requirements.check: Pressing and holding LEFT arrow key moves the player's fighter to the left.
requirements.quote: The Left and Right arrow keys walk the player

requirements.text: Right arrow key walks the player right.
requirements.check: Pressing and holding RIGHT arrow key moves the player's fighter to the right.
requirements.quote: The Left and Right arrow keys walk the player

requirements.text: Up arrow key makes the player jump.
requirements.check: Pressing UP arrow key makes the player's fighter move upwards and then fall back down.
requirements.quote: the Up arrow jumps

requirements.text: Space key makes the player throw a punch.
requirements.check: Pressing SPACE makes the player's fighter perform a punching animation/action.
requirements.quote: Space throws a punch.

requirements.text: A punch that lands pushes the opponent back a short fixed distance.
requirements.check: When a player's punch connects with the opponent, the opponent's x-position decreases (if facing right) or increases (if facing left) by a small amount.
requirements.quote: A punch that lands pushes the opponent back a short fixed distance

requirements.text: A punch that lands makes the opponent flash white briefly.
requirements.check: When a player's punch connects with the opponent, the opponent's sprite briefly changes to a white tint.
requirements.quote: makes it flash white briefly

requirements.text: A punch that lands removes 10 health.
requirements.check: When a player's punch connects with the opponent, the opponent's health bar decreases by 10 units.
requirements.quote: and removes 10 health.

requirements.text: The rival walks toward the player.
requirements.check: The rival fighter moves horizontally in the direction of the player fighter.
requirements.quote: The rival walks toward the player

requirements.text: The rival punches when close.
requirements.check: When the rival fighter is within a certain distance of the player, it performs a punching action.
requirements.quote: and punches when close

requirements.text: The rival has a one-second pause between punches.
requirements.check: After the rival punches, there is a delay of approximately one second before it can punch again.
requirements.quote: with a one-second pause between punches.

requirements.text: Each fighter has 100 health.
requirements.check: Both player and rival health bars start at full (representing 100 health).
requirements.quote: Each fighter has 100 health

requirements.text: Health is shown as a bar at the top of the screen.
requirements.check: Two health bars, one for the player and one for the rival, are displayed at the top of the game screen.
requirements.quote: shown as a bar at the top of the screen.

requirements.text: When a fighter reaches 0 health, show WIN or GAME OVER.
requirements.check: If the rival's health reaches 0, 'WIN' is displayed on screen. If the player's health reaches 0, 'GAME OVER' is displayed.
requirements.quote: When a fighter reaches 0 health, show WIN or GAME OVER

requirements.text: When a fighter reaches 0 health, freeze the game.
requirements.check: After 'WIN' or 'GAME OVER' is displayed, no fighters move or react to input (except restart/quit).
requirements.quote: and freeze the game.

requirements.text: Press R to restart the fight.
requirements.check: After a game ends, pressing 'R' resets the game state, including fighter positions and health, to the beginning.
requirements.quote: Press R to restart the fight

requirements.text: Press Escape to quit.
requirements.check: Pressing 'Escape' closes the game window.
requirements.quote: and Escape to quit.

requirements.text: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: MOVE LEFT, MOVE RIGHT, JUMP, PUNCH, RESTART and QUIT.
requirements.check: When the player presses LEFT, RIGHT, UP, SPACE, R, or ESCAPE, the corresponding action text is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: MOVE LEFT, MOVE RIGHT, JUMP, PUNCH, RESTART and QUIT

requirements.text: Print WIN or GAME OVER to the console when the fight ends.
requirements.check: When the game ends, either 'WIN' or 'GAME OVER' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: and print WIN or GAME OVER when the fight ends.

files.purpose: Main game loop, event handling, and game state management.
Defines the Fighter class for player and AI characters, including movement, punching, and health.
Stores game constants like screen dimensions, colors, and physics values.

assets.strategy_rationale: The spec explicitly asks for two small image assets for the fighters.

sprites.description: A pixel art red-belt martial artist fighter, facing sideways, in a fighting stance.
A pixel art blue-belt martial artist fighter, facing sideways, in a fighting stance.

architecture.test_input_example: Hold RIGHT for 120 frames, then repeatedly press SPACE every 60 frames until WIN or GAME OVER is displayed. Press R to restart. Press ESCAPE to quit.

unmapped.handling: Ensure no sound effects or background music are implemented in the game.

unmapped.quote: Keep the code simple and in as few files as possible.
unmapped.handling: The Coder should prioritize a clear, concise structure with minimal file separation, adhering to the provided file list.
